device_code.description: The device verification code used to poll the token endpoint

user_code.description: The user verification code displayed to the user

verification_uri.description: The URI where the user should enter the user code

verification_uri_complete.description: The complete URI including the user code (optional, for convenience)

expires_in.description: The lifetime in seconds of the device_code and user_code

interval.description: The minimum amount of time in seconds that the client should wait between polling requests
